note: MOD_PLAN.md section 6 item 4: STRATA_DMA_FLAG_WRITE (flag B written by the copy stream, hipStreamWriteValue32) and STRATA_PCIE_FORK (flag-B wait + PCIe groups on a forked stream) act only with a PCIe share, so the base is --pcie-frac 0.15 (spec 54's value). Lossy only against the preset arm (CPU vs GPU rows); the three switch arms are EXACT against pcie015 (same text required). The preset arm (pcie-frac 0) is the reference that decides whether a share with the fast flag path beats no share. Stop pancake.service first. DALI (MOD_PLAN.md section 6 item 13, coded 2026-11-15): STRATA_DALI=1 picks per layer and per step which missed experts the GPU reads over PCIe vs the CPU pool, from per-layer least-squares cost fits (row-weighted); the start share comes from --pcie-frac. NOT exact against pcie015 (other experts on the CPU vs the GPU): judge on tok/s; the per-layer split summary every 256 windows is in the engine log.
